title: Emergency kit basics (paraphrase)
excerpt: Public Ready.gov guidance commonly describes a household emergency kit as a stored set of supplies such as water, food, a flashlight, a battery-powered or hand-crank radio, extra batteries, a first-aid kit, medications list, copies of important papers, and supplies for pets if the household has them. This excerpt is bundled data for inspection, not a live alert and not a StormReady rule.
